name: Doll
source:
Kyoko is longing after love since her childhood. Her family was rich, but the love between her mom and dad fell out long time ago, and her mom not taking care of her anymore ...
Kyoko had become a woman who cannot love anybody ... except  one person ...

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE016581.html]DLsite[/url]]
